scenes.hook: Build a Personal Profile Card. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: A profile card combines meaningful content with a small reusable layout. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Start with an article, a heading, and a short introduction. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Add padding, a border, and consistent spacing in your stylesheet. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: If you include a portrait, give it appropriate alternative text. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Build a card with your name, a short bio, and one useful link. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
